description: List published pieces (summaries: slug, title, kind, date, counts of hard contradictions and naming/framing splits), newest first. All filters optional and combinable.

kind.description: Only pieces of this kind: 'audit' (discrepancy audit), 'coverage' (coverage brief), 'dispatch', or 'solo' (solo audit).

limit.description: Maximum results to return (default 25, hard cap 100).

outlet.description: Only pieces whose sources include this outlet, matched exactly but case-insensitively, e.g. 'Reuters' or 'Fox News'.

since.description: Only pieces dated on or after this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

until.description: Only pieces dated on or before this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: list_audits
